classes.description: A surface that samples a diffuse/livery/trim image stored on the disc (an embedded or shared texture is referenced). Drawn with that image. Does NOT apply when the only image slots are runtime-bound (envmap, logo, decal, metalflake, specular, licenseplate).

A surface with no on-disc diffuse image: paint, chrome, glass, window, black matte, carbon/paint wrappers whose look comes from runtime parameters or environment maps. Drawn with a neutral inspection colour.

A surface whose only job is a runtime effect, not body geometry: ground blob shadow, vinyl/logo decal layer whose logo texture is supplied at run time, or a speed-driven rim blur polygon. Precedence over the other classes. Drawn transparent or omitted.

args.purpose: Choose how a static MC3 preview should display each material class, from binding facts only.
